description: Closed stdout of the source-owned migration runner. Inspect is read-only; apply compares expected connection, journal existence, journal identities and pending identities again before effects. Arrays are sorted class names. No SQL, credentials, arbitrary commands or bootstrap output enter this protocol.

connectionFingerprint.description: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify({driver,host,port,database,schema,username}) in exactly that key order, with exact string values and integer port, without a trailing newline. The descriptor is the environment-authorized identity actually observed by the runner; URLs, userinfo and credential values are excluded.

journalFingerprintBefore.description: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(rows), without a trailing newline. Each row has keys id,timestamp,name in that order; rows are sorted by numeric id. id is a positive safe integer and timestamp a nonnegative safe integer. Decimal integer strings or bigint values are accepted only if exact and within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; unsafe conversion is refused. IDs and names are unique. Empty or absent journals hash []; existence is recorded separately.

journalFingerprintAfter.description: The same canonical full-row journal fingerprint as journalFingerprintBefore, measured after execution.

preservedJournalFingerprint.description: The canonical fingerprint of after-readback rows whose IDs belonged to the before journal, sorted by numeric id; it must equal journalFingerprintBefore. Inspect preserves its entire journal. Missing or rewritten prior rows therefore fail even when their names still appear.
